metadata.page_title: Sigma Chi Whiteout vs Nacua-Cola matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 9.3. Sigma Chi Whiteout left 4.0 lineup points on the table, while Nacua-Cola left 25.9.
summary.historical_summary: Sigma Chi Whiteout is 20-17 against Nacua-Cola across 37 meetings between these managers.
summary.winner_reason: Sigma Chi Whiteout won by 9.3, led by a 16.6-point edge at QB. The leading starters were Drake Maye (31.3) and Jonathan Taylor (21.0).
summary.loser_reason: Nacua-Cola could not match the opponent's QB production, losing that position battle by 16.6 points. Texans scored 3.0. Its best legal lineup added 25.9, enough to put the lineup decisions directly in the result.

metadata.page_title: Two Buck Luck vs ZSzizzle matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Two Buck Luck won by 27.9. Two Buck Luck left 20.4 lineup points on the table, while ZSzizzle left 8.5.
summary.historical_summary: This is the first recorded meeting between these managers. Two Buck Luck leads the manager series 1-0.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Two Buck Luck
summary.winner_reason: Two Buck Luck won by 27.9, led by a 30.7-point edge at RB. The leading starters were Javonte Williams (29.5) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (23.2).
summary.loser_reason: ZSzizzle could not match the opponent's RB production, losing that position battle by 30.7 points. Rams scored 2.0. A best legal lineup added 8.5, still short of the 27.9-point margin.
